title: _updatePhUSDEmissionRate truncates phUSDPerSecond to zero for small totalStaked at low APY, silently disabling phUSD emission
rootCause: Formula: `phUSDPerSecond = (totalStaked * desiredAPYBps) / 10000 / SECONDS_PER_YEAR`. With `SECONDS_PER_YEAR = 31_536_000` and `/ 10000`, the integer-division floor truncates to zero whenever `totalStaked * desiredAPYBps < 10000 * SECONDS_PER_YEAR = 3.1536e11`. Worked example: at `MINIMUM_STAKE = 1e15` (a single minimum staker) and `desiredAPYBps = 1` (0.01% APY), `1e15 * 1 / 10000 / 31_536_000 = 0`. No phUSD is ever minted for these stakers until either `totalStaked` rises or the APY rises.
impact: Silent under-payment of phUSD rewards to small stakers at small APYs. Combined with the dust-handler at `MINIMUM_STAKE = 1e15`, the boundary condition is exactly the smallest legal stake. A user with `1 phUSD * 100bps APY = 1e18 * 100 = 1e20 < 3.1536e11`? Actually 1e20 > 3.1536e11, so this only bites for tiny APYs (~< 1 bps) or sub-MINIMUM_STAKE positions (which the dust handler now prevents on stake but does not prevent post-pauseWithdraw, see I7). Treat as boundary / QA.
steps: Pool advances but no phUSD is ever accrued to accPhUSDPerShare for this staker.
remediation: Reorder to maximize precision: `phUSDPerSecond = (totalStaked * desiredAPYBps * PRECISION) / 10000 / SECONDS_PER_YEAR` and treat `phUSDPerSecond` as PRECISION-scaled (mirroring the stable-side accumulator) -- and then divide by PRECISION when accrueing. Or simply add a require / clamp so the rate cannot truncate to zero silently.
